ONE BRAND. EVERY NEXT CHAPTER.

The art of
staying consistent.

A practical design foundation for every new page, section, and moment in the Host Keira website.

TypographyColor paletteComponentsImplementation

01 / THE FOUNDATION

Warmth, with presence.

Elegant serif typography, warm cream, stage black, and a considered touch of gold. This standard consolidates the original website’s individual style choices into reusable rules. The live website and this guide share brand.css.

Personal

People and their stories come first. Let real moments and warm copy carry the page.

Assured

Clear hierarchy, generous space, and deliberate contrast. Give each section one focal point.

Celebratory

Gold adds a little ceremony. Use it for a detail, an accent, or the next meaningful action.

CSS uses rem units. Heading accents inherit their heading’s size. The standalone accent is 48 / 40 / 36px. Keep body text at 16px across all screens.

04 / SPACE + STRUCTURE

Room to breathe.

RuleDesktopTabletMobile
Section vertical padding108px76px64px
Side gutters8%6%7%
Grid columns321
Grid gap40px32px24px

Content max: 1600px. Reading max: 65ch. Space steps: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 64, 80, 96px.

Square corners and thin rules are the default. Reserve circles for monograms and small identity details. The existing hero is a composition exception; new sections begin with the shared grid.

05 / COMPONENTS

Familiar, every time.

Actions on cream

Plan your eventExplore servicesMeet Keira

Actions on black

Plan your eventExplore servicesMeet Keira

Form styles

Style specimens only; no information is submitted.

Use 54px controls, 14px labels, 16px input text, and visible keyboard focus. Errors need words as well as color. Never imply that a booking was sent by the current copy-to-Instagram flow.

06 / NAVIGATION + MOTION

A little theatre.

The menu

A black-and-gold full-screen dialog at 600px and below. Numbered serif links, a fine frame, and a champagne booking panel.

The movement

200ms hovers. 420ms reveal. A restrained 60ms link stagger. Reduced-motion settings remove movement.

The behavior

Escape closes. Focus returns. Background scrolling pauses. The menu scrolls on shorter screens. Links move focus to their destination.

07 / IMAGERY + VOICE

Real warmth.
Real connection.

Photography

Warm event light, natural skin tones, and candid human connection. Preserve the subject in mobile crops. Current mood-board imagery is provisional, not verified event work.

Identity

Fine outline icons, occasional gold stars, and restrained monograms. Use approved original logo files when available. Never stretch a wordmark or invent a new variant per page.

Language

Personal, confident, and specific. Keep the client at the center. Preserve authentic reviews. Never invent credentials, contact information, or event history.

08 / BUILD WITH THE BRAND

One shared foundation.

Load brand.css before your page’s layout stylesheet. Reuse its tokens and hk- classes. The home page also loads styles.css for its specific layouts.

Download brand.cssView the website
  1. Use semantic headings and the shared responsive scale.
  2. Reuse colors, space tokens, and components before writing new CSS.
  3. Check 390px, 768px, and 1440px; include long content and 200% text enlargement.
  4. Verify keyboard access, reduced motion, real imagery, and honest form states.
  5. Update the stylesheet and both guides together when the brand changes.
